title: File Management
summary: This module handles file operations, including caching, cleanup, and resolution of various file sources, ensuring efficient and secure file handling within the system.

nodes.label: Normalize File Sources
nodes.title: Normalize File Sources
nodes.description: Converts various input types (paths, URLs, bytes, streams) into standardized FileSource objects for consistent processing.

nodes.label: Create File Resolver
nodes.title: Create File Resolver
nodes.description: Initializes a FileResolver with configurable settings for file upload preferences, size thresholds, and caching.

nodes.label: Synchronous Cache Cleanup
nodes.title: Synchronous Cache Cleanup
nodes.description: Manages the removal of expired or provider-specific files from the cache and optionally from the storage provider in a synchronous manner.

nodes.label: Asynchronous Cache Cleanup
nodes.title: Asynchronous Cache Cleanup
nodes.description: Handles the removal of expired or provider-specific files from the cache and storage provider asynchronously, supporting concurrent operations.

nodes.label: Log File Operations
nodes.title: Log File Operations
nodes.description: Records detailed metrics and events for all file-related actions, including success, failure, duration, and file metadata.

nodes.label: Retrieve Stored Files
nodes.title: Retrieve Stored Files
nodes.description: Provides functionality to retrieve files associated with specific execution or task IDs from the file store.

groups.label: File Resolution
groups.title: File Resolution
groups.description: Manages the conversion of diverse file inputs into standardized formats and configures how files are handled and uploaded.

groups.label: Cache Management
groups.title: Cache Management
groups.description: Handles the lifecycle of cached files, including cleanup of expired or provider-specific data, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous operations.

groups.label: Monitoring and Retrieval
groups.title: Monitoring and Retrieval
groups.description: Provides logging for file operations and mechanisms to retrieve files based on execution or task identifiers.
